purpose: Define remediation suggestions as explicit non-authoritative mappings from error conditions to safe candidate operations, never automatic hidden execution.

topics.name: Runtime Error Remediation
topics.purpose: Define remediation suggestions as explicit non-authoritative mappings from error conditions to safe candidate operations, never automatic hidden execution.

semantics.mapping_rule: Error type/condition may reference exact remediation operation/template identities.
semantics.candidate_rule: Suggested remediation is inert candidate guidance until explicitly invoked.
semantics.determinism_rule: A remediation line is emitted only when a deterministic safe action is known.
semantics.single_line_rule: Where command UX requires it, one concise remediation line is preferred over ambiguous option spam.
semantics.failure_rule: Unknown remediation remains explicit rather than guessed.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.
